ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

media-carousel.description: Rotating banner and image viewport with arrows, dot navigation, and keyboard support.

autoplay.note: With autoplay, the active dot fills over the duration and pauses on hover, focus, hidden tabs, and reduced motion. The toggle pauses and resumes.

dots-outside.note: Dots render below the viewport instead of overlaid on the image.

examples.label: Featured stories
examples.note: One slide visible at a time. Use the arrows or dots to move, or focus the viewport and use the arrow keys.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

loop.note: With loop off, the arrows clamp at the first and last slide and expose aria-disabled.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.
